name: Andhra Pradesh
agro_climatic_zone: Southern Plateau and Hills / East Coast Plains and Hills
challenges: Drought in Rayalaseema belt (Anantapur, Kurnool)
Cyclone damage in coastal delta
Groundwater depletion
Pest incidence in Chilli (Thrips) and Cotton (Pink Bollworm)
institutions: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Guntur
Dr. Y.S.R. Horticultural University, Venkataramannagudem
key_advisory: Focus on micro-irrigation in Rayalaseema; adopt IPM for Chilli Black Thrips; practice Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) to save 30% water in Godavari-Krishna deltas.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
challenges: Shifting (Jhum) cultivation soil erosion
Steep hill terrain mechanization hurdles
High soil acidity (pH 4.5 - 5.5)
Lack of cold chain infrastructure
institutions: College of Horticulture & Forestry (CAU), Pasighat
ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region, Basar
key_advisory: Apply agricultural lime (1-2 tonnes/ha) to neutralise soil acidity; expand organic Kiwi and large cardamom export clusters; promote terraced wet rice cultivation.

name: Assam
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region (Brahmaputra & Barak Valleys)
challenges: Annual Brahmaputra flash floods washing away standing crops
Siltation of paddy fields
Low fertilizer consumption efficiency
Storage losses in Boro rice
institutions: Assam Agricultural University (AAU), Jorhat
Tocklai Tea Research Institute, Jorhat
key_advisory: Sow flood-tolerant submerged rice varieties (Swarna-Sub1, Bahadur-Sub1); expand post-flood Rabi crops (Mustard, Potato, Boro rice) on residual moisture.

name: Bihar
agro_climatic_zone: Middle Gangetic Plain (North West Alluvial, North East Alluvial, South Alluvial)
challenges: Severe dichotomy: North Bihar floods vs South Bihar droughts
Tal area water stagnation during Kharif
High fragmentation of landholdings
High cost of diesel for irrigation
institutions: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU), Pusa, Samastipur
Bihar Agricultural University (BAU), Sabour
key_advisory: Adopt high-yielding Rabi maize and zero-tillage wheat; commercialise Makhana and Litchi processing; utilise Tal lands for intensive Rabi pulse production.

name: Chhattisgarh
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Plateau and Hills (Chhattisgarh Plains, Bastar Plateau, Northern Hills)
challenges: Mono-cropping of long duration paddy
Terminal drought during grain filling stage
Low Rabi cropping intensity (Utera cropping reliant on residual moisture)
institutions: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), Raipur
National Institute of Biotic Stress Management (NIBSM), Raipur
key_advisory: Promote Shree Anna (Kodo-Kutki millets) in Bastar and Northern hills; switch from broadcasting to line sowing/SRI in paddy; expand drip-irrigated Rabi vegetables.

name: Goa
agro_climatic_zone: West Coast Plains and Ghats
kharif_crops: Paddy (Korgut salt-tolerant variety in Khazan lands)
challenges: Intrusion of saline sea water through breached Khazan dykes
Labor shortage and high agricultural wages
Damage by wild boars and peacocks
institutions: ICAR - Central Coastal Agricultural Research Institute (CCARI), Ela, Old Goa
key_advisory: Maintain traditional sluice gates in Khazan ecosystems; expand organic Cashew and Mankurad mango orchards; intercrop black pepper with arecanut.

name: Gujarat
agro_climatic_zone: Gujarat Plains and Hills (South Gujarat, North Gujarat, Saurashtra, Kutch)
challenges: Pink Bollworm resistance in Bt cotton
Soil salinity ingress in coastal Saurashtra and South Gujarat
Groundwater overexploitation in North Gujarat
institutions: Anand Agricultural University (AAU)
Junagadh Agricultural University (JAU)
Navsari Agricultural University (NAU)
S.D. Agricultural University, Dantiwada
key_advisory: Mandatory installation of pheromone traps for Cotton Pink Bollworm; adopt micro-irrigation for Cumin and Potato; cultivate Bhalia wheat in rainfed Bhal tract.

name: Haryana
agro_climatic_zone: Trans-Gangetic Plain
challenges: Paddy stubble burning causing Delhi-NCR air pollution
Depletion of fresh groundwater aquifers
Terminal heat stress in late-sown wheat
Soil sodicity in canal commands
institutions: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University (CCSHAU), Hisar
ICAR-Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI), Karnal
ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat & Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
key_advisory: Shift from water-guzzling paddy to DSR, Maize, and Pulses under Mera Pani Meri Virasat; utilize Happy Seeder and Super SMS for stubble in-situ management; apply Gypsum on sodic soils.

name: Himachal Pradesh
agro_climatic_zone: Western Himalayan Region (Sub-mountain, Mid-hills, High-hills, Cold dry zone)
challenges: Hailstorms and untimely spring snow damaging apple bloom
Apple scab disease and mite infestations
Wild animal / monkey menace in mid-hills
Lack of chilling hours due to warming winters
institutions: Dr. Y.S. Parmar University of Horticulture and Forestry, Nauni, Solan
CSK Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya, Palampur
key_advisory: Transition to low-chilling high-density apple varieties on dwarf rootstocks (M9, MM106); install anti-hail nets; adopt Subhash Palekar Natural Farming (SPNF/Prakritik Kheti).

name: Jharkhand
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Plateau and Hills (Central, Western & South Eastern Plateaus)
challenges: Steep undulating topography leading to rapid rainwater runoff
High soil acidity and micronutrient deficiencies (Boron, Zinc)
Drought vulnerability in Palamu plateau
institutions: Birsa Agricultural University (BAU), Kanke, Ranchi
ICAR Research Complex for Eastern Region, Ranchi
key_advisory: Adopt Ridge and Furrow planting on Tanr lands; apply lime or basic slag @ 2-4 q/ha to acidic soils; harvest monsoon runoff in Dobhas for life-saving Rabi irrigation.

name: Karnataka
agro_climatic_zone: Southern Plateau and Hills / West Coast Plains & Ghats (10 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Frequent droughts in Northern Dry Zone (Vijayapura, Bagalkot, Gadag)
Borewell drying up in Kolar-Chikkaballapur
Leaf spot in Arecanut (Koleroga)
Coffee Berry Borer
institutions: University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS), Bengaluru
University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS), Dharwad
University of Horticultural Sciences (UHS), Bagalkot
key_advisory: Intercrop Pigeonpea with Ragi or Groundnut in South Karnataka; adopt wide-row spacing and ridge-furrow for Rabi Jowar in North; apply Bordeaux mixture (1%) for Koleroga in Arecanut.

name: Kerala
agro_climatic_zone: West Coast Plains and Ghats
challenges: High soil acidity (pH 4.2 - 5.5) and aluminum toxicity
Extreme flood vulnerability in Kuttanad below sea-level farming
Labor shortages and high farm labor costs
Root wilt disease in Coconut
institutions: Kerala Agricultural University (KAU), Vellanikkara, Thrissur
ICAR-Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Kozhikode
key_advisory: Adopt salt-tolerant Pokkali and Kuttanad-specific deep water rice; apply dolomite/lime based on soil health cards; manage Cardamom thrips with integrated bio-control.

name: Madhya Pradesh
agro_climatic_zone: Central Plateau and Hills / Western Plateau (11 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Soybean yellow mosaic virus & pod blight during irregular monsoons
Frost injury to gram and mustard in Gwalior-Chambal belt
Gully erosion and ravines in Chambal region
institutions: Jawaharlal Nehru Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (JNKVV), Jabalpur
Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya (RVSKVV), Gwalior
ICAR-Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR), Indore
key_advisory: Use Broad Bed and Furrow (BBF) seed drills for Soybean to prevent waterlogging; treat gram seeds with Trichoderma + Rhizobium to prevent Fusarium wilt; expand certified Sharbati wheat.

name: Maharashtra
agro_climatic_zone: Western Plateau and Hills / West Coast (9 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Severe agrarian distress in Vidarbha and rain-shadow Marathwada
High water demand of sugarcane draining ground aquifers
Extreme onion price volatility and post-harvest rot
Tuta absoluta and thrips in horticulture
institutions: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri
Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (PDKV), Akola
Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani
Dr. Balasaheb Sawant Konkan Krishi Vidyapeeth (DBSKKV), Dapoli
key_advisory: Compulsory drip irrigation for Sugarcane under PMKSY; adopt BBF system for Soybean-Pigeonpea intercropping (4:2); build ventilated onion storage structures (Kanda Chawl).

name: Manipur
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
challenges: Terrain inaccessibility in hill districts
High soil acidity reducing phosphorus availability
Limited post-harvest cold storage for perishable fruits
institutions: Central Agricultural University (CAU), Iroisemba, Imphal
ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region, Manipur Centre, Lamphelpat
key_advisory: Commercialise Chak-hao Black Rice organic export supply chains; expand Kachai Lemon orchards in Ukhrul; apply Rock Phosphate + PSB for acidic soils.

name: Meghalaya
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
challenges: Extremely high rainfall causing intense topsoil leaching
Low soil pH (4.0 - 5.0) causing phosphorus fixation
Difficult transport logistics across hilly valleys
institutions: ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region, Umiam, Barapani
College of Post Graduate Studies in Agricultural Sciences (CAU), Umiam
key_advisory: Leverage Mission Lakadong for high-curcumin turmeric export; utilize traditional bamboo drip irrigation for betel leaf and black pepper; practice contour bunding.

name: Mizoram
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
horticulture: Mizo Chilli (Bird's Eye / Mizo Vaimim - GI)
challenges: Shifting jhum agriculture causing forest loss and erosion
Extreme steep slopes (steepest in NE)
Scarcity of water during dry winter months despite heavy monsoon
institutions: College of Veterinary Sciences & Animal Husbandry (CAU), Selesih, Aizawl
KVK network across Kolasib and Champhai
key_advisory: Implement New Land Use Policy (NLUP) to settle jhumias in permanent horticulture; construct Jalkund plastic-lined rainwater harvest tanks on ridges.

name: Nagaland
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
irrigation_sources: Ruza / Zabo indigenous water harvesting system
challenges: Steep slope erosion
Acidic soil fertility depletion
Limited cold storage and agro-processing facilities in remote hill blocks
institutions: School of Agricultural Sciences and Rural Development (SASRD), Nagaland University, Medziphema
ICAR Nagaland Centre, Jharnapani
key_advisory: Scale the ancient indigenous 'Zabo' system combining forestry, agriculture, and fisheries; establish processing clusters for GI Naga Mircha and Sweet Cucumber.

name: Odisha
agro_climatic_zone: East Coast Plains and Hills / Eastern Plateau (10 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Recurring Bay of Bengal cyclones damaging coastal crops
Droughts in Western KBK districts (Kalahandi, Balangir, Koraput)
Saline inundation in coastal belts during storm surges
institutions: Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT), Bhubaneswar
ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
ICAR-Central Institute of Freshwater Aquaculture (CIFA), Bhubaneswar
key_advisory: Promote climate-resilient flood/saline rice varieties (CR Dhan 407, Luna Sankhi); scale Odisha Millets Mission for nutritional security in tribal pockets; adopt rice-fallow pulse cropping.

name: Punjab
agro_climatic_zone: Trans-Gangetic Plain Region (Sub-mountain undulating, Central plain, South-western)
irrigation_sources: Sirhind, Bhakra & Upper Bari Doab Canals
Over 1.5 Million Deep Electric Tube Wells (99% irrigated)
challenges: Severe groundwater table decline (critical dark zones)
Paddy residue burning causing massive seasonal smog
Micro-nutrient depletion (Zinc, Manganese, Iron, Sulphur) from intensive rice-wheat cycle
institutions: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana
Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana
key_advisory: Adopt Direct Seeded Rice (Tar-wattar DSR) saving 15-20% water; use Happy Seeder and Smart Seeder for zero-till wheat into stubble; diversify 10% area into Maize, Pulses, and Kinnow.

name: Rajasthan
agro_climatic_zone: Western Dry Region / Central Plateau and Hills (10 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Extreme arid climate and high summer evaporation (>45°C)
Deep, brackish, and fluoride-rich groundwater
Locust swarms from border deserts
Wind erosion shifting sand dunes
institutions: Swami Keshwanand Rajasthan Agricultural University (SKRAU), Bikaner
Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture and Technology (MPUAT), Udaipur
ICAR-Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI), Jodhpur
key_advisory: Adopt CAZRI agri-horti-silvipastoral models (Khejri + Ber/Gonda + Cenchrus grass); apply drip irrigation with solar pumping under PM-KUSUM; intercrop Moth bean with Bajra.

name: Sikkim
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
challenges: 100% Certified Organic State: ban on synthetic chemical fertilizers and pesticides requires 100% bio-inputs
Soil acidity and fast nutrient leaching
Cardamom chirke & foorkey viral diseases
institutions: ICAR-National Research Centre for Orchids, Pakyong
ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region, Sikkim Centre, Tadong
key_advisory: Use Trichoderma viride and neem cakes for bio-disease management; rejuvenate old cardamom plantations with virus-free tissue culture clones; compost vermicompost on terraces.

name: Tamil Nadu
agro_climatic_zone: Southern Plateau and Hills / East Coast Plains and Hills (7 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Inter-state Cauvery water dispute reducing Kuruvai inflows
Severe dependence on retreating North-East Monsoon (Oct-Dec)
Salinity ingress in coastal Thanjavur & Nagapattinam
institutions: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU), Coimbatore
ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI), Coimbatore
ICAR-National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB), Tiruchirappalli
key_advisory: Adopt System of Rice Intensification (SRI) and Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD); sow pulse seeds in standing paddy 7-10 days before harvest (rice fallow pulse); expand precision micro-irrigation.

name: Telangana
agro_climatic_zone: Southern Plateau and Hills (Northern Telangana, Southern Telangana, High Altitude)
challenges: Excessive procurement pressure of parboiled rice in Rabi season
Pink Bollworm in Cotton
Lowering water tables in crystalline rock aquifers of Mahabubnagar
institutions: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad
ICAR-Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad
key_advisory: Diversify away from Rabi paddy into Oilseeds (Groundnut, Sesame, Mustard) and Pulses; enforce refuge non-Bt border rows for Cotton; promote Tandur Red Gram cultivation.

name: Tripura
agro_climatic_zone: Eastern Himalayan Region
horticulture: Rubber (Tripura is 2nd largest producer after Kerala)
challenges: High soil acidity (pH 4.5 - 5.5) with low organic carbon retention
Flash floods in Gumti and Howrah river basins
Cross-border market linkages hurdles
institutions: College of Agriculture, Tripura (CAU), Lembucherra
ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region, Tripura Centre, Lembucherra
key_advisory: Apply lime (300-400 kg/ha in furrows); expand Queen Pineapple processing and GI branding; intercrop legumes during immature phase of rubber plantations.

name: Uttar Pradesh
agro_climatic_zone: Upper Gangetic Plain / Middle Gangetic Plain / Central Plateau (9 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Drought and rocky terrain in Bundelkhand plateau (Jhansi, Banda, Mahoba)
Waterlogging and floods in Eastern Terai belt
Stray cattle menace (Anna Pratha)
Payment delays in sugar mills
institutions: Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture and Technology (CSAUAT), Kanpur
Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology (NDUAT), Ayodhya
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University (SVPUAT), Meerut
Banda University of Agriculture and Technology (BUAT), Banda
ICAR-Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR), Lucknow
ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH), Lucknow
key_advisory: Plant Trench / Ring-pit Sugarcane with drip irrigation; adopt drought-hardy pulses and oilseeds in Bundelkhand; integrate short-duration Mentha (Koshi variety) in Zaid.

name: Uttarakhand
agro_climatic_zone: Western Himalayan Region (Tarai-Bhabar, Valley, Mid-hills, High-hills)
challenges: Terrace abandonment and hill village out-migration (Ghost villages)
Severe human-wildlife conflict (Wild boars, monkeys)
Cloudbursts and hillside flash landslides
institutions: G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology (GBPUAT), Pantnagar (Cradle of Green Revolution)
ICAR-Vivekananda Parvatiya Krishi Anusandhan Sansthan (VPKAS), Almora
key_advisory: Scale GI-tagged hill traditional crops (Mandua, Jhangora, Gahat/Kulthi dal); adopt solar wire fencing against wild animals; establish cold storage for Tarai seed crops.

name: West Bengal
agro_climatic_zone: Lower Gangetic Plain / Eastern Himalayan (6 Agro-climatic zones)
challenges: Arsenic contamination in shallow groundwater (Nadia, Murshidabad, 24 Parganas)
Cyclone surges salinizing Sundarbans delta farmlands
Storage & price crises in Potato
institutions: Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya (BCKV), Mohanpur, Nadia
Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya (UBKV), Pundibari, Cooch Behar
ICAR-Central Research Institute for Jute and Allied Fibres (CRIJAF), Barrackpore
key_advisory: Adopt arsenic-safe deep tube-wells and surface irrigation; plant salt-tolerant rice (Dudheshwar, Hamilton) in Sundarbans; practice ribbon retting for superior quality jute fiber.

name: Delhi (NCT)
agro_climatic_zone: Trans-Gangetic Plain
zaid_crops: Cucurbits (Ridge gourd, Bottle gourd, Cucumber) on Yamuna riverbed
challenges: Rapid urban sprawl swallowing agricultural land
Yamuna water pollution with heavy metals
Groundwater salinity in Najafgarh block
institutions: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI - Pusa), New Delhi
ICAR Headquarters, Krishi Bhavan
key_advisory: Adopt hydroponics, rooftop polyhouses, and vertical farming; cultivate flower and exotic salad greens for high-value Delhi-NCR urban markets.

name: Jammu & Kashmir
agro_climatic_zone: Western Himalayan Region (Sub-tropical Jammu, Temperate Kashmir)
challenges: Untimely early snowfall breaking apple branches
Corm rot disease in Saffron fields
Apple scab and leaf blotch epidemics
Adulteration of genuine Kashmiri saffron
institutions: Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Kashmir (SKUAST-K), Shalimar, Srinagar
SKUAST-Jammu, Chatha
key_advisory: Rejuvenate Saffron under National Saffron Mission with sprinkler irrigation; transition to high-density spur apple cultivars; cultivate GI Mushqbudji aromatic rice.

name: Ladakh
agro_climatic_zone: Western Himalayan Region (Cold Arid Desert)
soil_types: Sandy to Gravelly Skeletal Soil (Alkaline pH 7.8 - 8.6, low organic carbon)
irrigation_sources: Artificial Glaciers / Ice Stupas (Sonam Wangchuk innovation)
kharif_crops: Single cropped season (May - Sept): Naked Barley (Grim)
rabi_crops: Extreme freezing winter (-20°C to -35°C): Passive Solar Trench Greenhouses only
challenges: Extremely short 120-day frost-free growing window
Extreme sub-zero winter temperatures
Glacier retreat reducing spring sowing irrigation water
institutions: DIHAR (Defence Institute of High Altitude Research - DRDO), Leh
High Altitude Mountain Agriculture Research Station (SKUAST), Leh
key_advisory: Build Ice Stupas for March-April sowing irrigation; use Ladakh passive solar polyhouses for winter vegetable production; commercialise GI Raktsey Karpo Apricot and Seabuckthorn juice.

name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
agro_climatic_zone: Island Region (Humid Tropical Island Ecosystem)
challenges: Steep slope soil erosion under 3000mm rainfall
Low water storage in dry summer months (Feb-April)
Pest infestation in humid coconut plantations (Rhinoceros beetle)
institutions: ICAR-Central Island Agricultural Research Institute (CIARI), Port Blair
key_advisory: Adopt Broad Bed and Furrow (BBF) in valley lands for rice-fish-vegetable integration; plant multi-tier spice cropping with Coconut.

name: Chandigarh
agro_climatic_zone: Trans-Gangetic Plain
challenges: Shrinking farmland footprint due to urban expansion
Groundwater recharge management
institutions: Regional Station ICAR / Panjab University Botany & Agri Extension
key_advisory: Focus on high-value organic rooftop gardening, automated hydroponics, and commercial ornamental plant nurseries.

name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
agro_climatic_zone: Gujarat Plains and Hills / West Coast
challenges: Industrial effluent pressure on soil
Saline water intrusion along Daman & Diu coastal edges
institutions: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), Silvassa
key_advisory: Promote indigenous finger millet (Nagali) value-addition; intercrop vegetables with mango and sapodilla orchards.

name: Lakshadweep
agro_climatic_zone: Island Region (Coral Atoll Ecosystem)
soil_types: Coral Sandy Soil (Highly calcareous, 90% CaCO3, alkaline pH 8.0 - 8.5, low fertility)
irrigation_sources: Freshwater Coral Lens (Hand pumps, delicate ecology)
challenges: Strict ban on chemical inputs; coral limestone ground with zero clay
Fragile thin freshwater lens that turns saline if over-pumped
High rat damage to tender coconuts
institutions: ICAR-CPCRI Regional Station, Minicoy
Department of Agriculture, Kavaratti
key_advisory: Apply organic seaweed compost and vermicompost to coral sands; fix metal bands around coconut trunks to prevent rodent damage; expand copra processing.

name: Puducherry
agro_climatic_zone: East Coast Plains and Hills
challenges: Over-extraction of coastal groundwater causing sea-water ingress in Puducherry town aquifers
Cyclone vulnerabilities in Karaikal and Yanam
institutions: Perunthalaivar Kamaraj Krishi Vigyan Kendra (PKKVK), Puducherry
Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru College of Agriculture and Research Institute (PAJANCOA & RI), Karaikal
key_advisory: Recharge groundwater using artificial recharge shafts; adopt coastal saline-tolerant rice varieties in Karaikal; shift to precision drip irrigation for vegetables.
